name: strongly_connected_components
author: e2346c64
description: Finds the strongly connected components (SCCs) of a directed graph with Kosaraju's algorithm (two depth-first passes): maximal groups where every node can reach every other following edge directions. Use for: Which groups of airports/accounts all reach each other? Can you get from X to Y and back? Is the network strongly connected? Does a directed graph contain cycles (any SCC larger than 1)? Directed graphs only; for undirected graphs use connected_components. Returns num_components, largest_size, singleton and non-trivial counts, and the top_k largest SCCs (rank, size, fraction, sample members). Each listed SCC is registered as a subgraph (its graph_id); result_graph_id is the largest SCC.

graph_id.description: Id of a directed graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many of the largest components to list.

node.description: Optional node id; also reports the SCC containing this node. Use lookup_node to find ids.
